poc_plan: Phase 1 — Baseline functional: 2 days; run 50k chat tokens, validate correctness vs reference outputs
Phase 2 — Load ramp: 1 day; ramp to 100 concurrent streams, measure latency P50/P95/P99 under steady-state
Phase 3 — Soak test: 72 hours sustained at 65% reserved capacity to observe memory/KV cache behavior
Phase 4 — Peak spike tests: burst to 250% reserved capacity for 10-30 minute windows to test autoscale/fallback
Phase 5 — Reranking sweep: 2000 qps blend of short/long contexts to validate throughput and batching behavior
Artifacts to collect: token-level latency traces, per-GPU utilization, queue depths, KV cache hit rates, billing simulation
performance_targets: Sustained throughput target: 200k tokens/hour during core hours
Concurrent streams target: 100 steady, 250 short bursts
Latency SLOs: P50 per-token <= 45ms, P95 per-token <= 180ms, P99 tail analyzed and mitigated
Availability target (SLA ask): 99.9% for inference endpoints, credits model for SLA misses
Reserved GPU planning: initial reserved pool = 16 x A100-80GB equivalent; burst pool via autoscale up to +8 GPUs
test_artifacts: Representative prompt set: 12k chat prompts (mix of long/short), 2k rerank requests, 5k summarization samples
Load generator config: k6 scripts + custom token streamer (repo link stub)
Monitoring dashboards: per-route latency, token rate, cost-per-token simulation
Security docs: HSM integration note, SOC2 attestation link
negotiation_notes: Customer requests latency SLOs tied to credits; wants detailed escalation path for region failover
Legal asks for 12-month reserved commitment with review windows at 30/60/90 days
Finance prefers a blended rate: lower base for reserved capacity + usage-based burst pricing
technical_risks: KV cache warm-up during sudden traffic spikes causing transient latency tail
Regional capacity: customer needs EU residency for ~30% of traffic — requires Private/VPC placement in eu-central
Model compatibility: current preferred open model needs quantized build validated on Dedicated runtime
acceptance_criteria: Pass 72h soak with P95 latency <= 180ms and no 15+ minute outage
